About this lexicon

This edition combines the Modern Mystery dictionary with the recorded Classical Mystery vocabulary. Classical inflection tables appear only where documented. Recent compounds without full paradigms are listed separately.

Source groups have neutral names. Earlier forms belong to the language’s internal reconstruction; they are not necessarily attested words. Homographs have separate entries. Search accepts either stage, inflected forms, English meanings and unaccented spellings.
